title: Haru Invest legal process coverage
notes: Supports legal-process context and the reported February 2024 indictment after Haru suspended withdrawals.

title: Seoul Bankruptcy Court declares Haru Management Limited bankrupt
notes: Contemporaneous court report states that the Seoul Bankruptcy Court declared Haru Management Limited bankrupt after finding grounds of inability to pay, and identifies the company as the Haru Invest operating entity responsible for membership, product subscriptions, and customer virtual-asset management. It supports bankruptcy status and creditor-process context only; it does not establish a completed distribution, universal recovery percentage, or final criminal liability.

title: Haru Invest describes trading-based yield-generation strategy
notes: Company-attributed release states that Haru Invest offered Earn Plus and Earn Explore and described its crypto-fund management as based on trading models exploiting market inefficiencies to generate profits. This resolves only the existence of a disclosed source-of-yield mechanism. It does not independently verify realized returns, asset segregation, custody treatment, or whether the stated strategies matched actual deployment of all customer assets. Linked to the platform launch/product lineage event for schema continuity; the 2023 disclosure date is not treated as the product launch date.

title: Prosecutors alleged Haru marketed risk-free principal-guaranteed returns
notes: Contemporaneous reporting of the Seoul Southern District Prosecutors' Office indictment states that prosecutors alleged Haru executives attracted deposits by representing risk-free management, principal protection and industry-leading returns. This is recorded strictly as a prosecution allegation about customer-facing representations, not as an adjudicated finding that principal was in fact guaranteed or protected, and not as proof of realized returns or actual asset deployment.
